Description: Wrapped each social_*_link in a `{% if ... != blank %}` conditional so only populated URLs are emitted into the schema.org sameAs array. Added a social_sep variable to handle commas correctly without trailing/leading commas. Also included social_linkedin_link and social_whatsapp_link, which were configured in settings but missing from the original array.
Reason: SEO crawlers were flagging the homepage because the sameAs array contained 6 empty strings ('""') alongside the 3 real URLs (Facebook/Snapchat/YouTube) — empty entries in structured data signal sloppy implementation and weaken the Organization knowledge-graph signals.
Before: sameAs array unconditionally rendered all 9 social_*_link settings, producing 6 empty strings for unset values
After: sameAs array contains only the populated social URLs (currently: Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Snapchat, YouTube)
